findings.claim: The required stdio gate did not explicitly prove MCP 2026-07-28 negotiation.
findings.evidence: The client used the default lifecycle and asserted identity and inventory without asserting the negotiated peer protocol.
findings.suggested_fix: Request 2026-07-28 explicitly and assert the negotiated peer protocol before the remaining checks.

findings.claim: The Codex harness did not validate or emit the exact client version required by the matrix contract.
findings.evidence: The receipt contained client, transport, tool, and evidence but no version, discovery outcome, invocation outcome, or explicit pass status.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate the binary version and include exact version plus discovery, invocation, and overall status fields.

findings.claim: An identifier-only whitespace-header baseline could mask a future header regression.
findings.evidence: The upstream expected-failure format matches only the check identifier.
findings.suggested_fix: Cause-gate the expected failure or use valid tool arguments, and retain an end-to-end HTTP regression.
